Genuine NISSAN CVT Fluid NS-3 only. Do not mix with other fluids. Do not use ATF or manual transmission fluid.

extraction_caveats: 1. The schedule pages (pp. 451–467) present individual mileage columns rather than a single consolidated interval table; intervals were reconstructed by identifying the repeating pattern across columns. 2. The severe-use schedule repeats the same inspection list every 5,000 mi / 6 mo with engine oil & filter replacement; brake fluid, differential gear oil, and transfer fluid replacements appear at specific severe-use milestones rather than a clean repeating interval. 3. CVT fluid, differential gear oil, transfer oil, and PSF capacities are listed as '—' (not specified) in the fluids table on p. 470. 4. Transfer fluid specification is not named beyond the capacity table entry in the provided pages. 5. Spark plug replacement interval mileage is referenced but the specific interval value does not appear in the provided pages. 6. Engine valve clearance has no fixed interval — inspect only if noise increases. 7. Items marked with '*' in the manual (engine coolant, engine drive belts, fuel tank vapor vent system, fuel lines/connections, engine valve clearance) are recommended by Nissan but not required to maintain emission warranty. 8. The severe-use differential gear oil and transfer fluid replacement milestones were read from the essential replacement entries at 20,000 / 40,000 / 60,000 / 80,000 / 100,000 mi; the interval is approximately 20,000 mi but not perfectly uniform. 9. Engine drive belts first inspection is at 60,000 mi standard, then every 15,000 mi (75k, 90k, 105k). 10. Intelligent Key battery appears as inspection at 22,500 mi and replacement at 45,000 / 67,500 / 90,000 / 112,500 mi — every 22,500 mi / 18 months.
